Author: NeonGhostCinnamon
Name: Will-o-Muter
Punchline: Mutes the ambient sounds when a crowd gathers around you.
Description: Tired of noisy crowds? Will-o-Muter mutes the Ambient Sounds channel when many players are nearby and restores your volume once the crowd thins out. Open the settings with /willomuter.
Changelog:
First release of Will-o-Muter (formerly CrowdMute): a quieter Eorzea.

- Mutes the Ambient Sounds channel when a crowd gathers around you, and restores it when the crowd thins out
- New look matching Will-o-Patchwisp: light and dark theme, glass cards, compact minimized bar
- Live nearby-player counter with a Muted / Unmuted badge
- Adjustable mute threshold, unmute margin, radius and unmute delay
- Ko-fi and GitHub buttons
